g.text: D04 S-1 Submit a planning job
count jobs of the branch in PROCESSING
load orders by id and branch
[an order is missing, foreign, or not SCHEDULED]
message names up to 10 order codes
load vehicles by id and branch
drop vehicles banned all day at their depot
"No usable vehicle: every depot lies in a zone that bans the vehicle all day"
The transaction has not committed when the
controller returns, so the status in the response
The dispatch is best-effort: one attempt, no retry, no outbox.
A FAILED row is visible to the planner but is never re-sent.
orderIds and vehicleIds may be null or empty, and an
empty job is created and dispatched.
ASSUMPTION: this is a defect, not an intended feature.
